lead: `serve::tests::the_in_flight_ceiling_is_fleet_wide_so_a_hot_core_cannot_refuse_while_neighbours_idle` fails under load and passes alone
body: , and `verify.py`'s message for it names a shared port, path or container, none of which it has. It drives a fleet-wide semaphore across threads, so a loaded machine lets one core's handler run after the ceiling already refused it — a session whose diff is nowhere near `crates/nvs-server` can spend calls proving the failure is not its own. Re-run `python tools/verify.py` and only investigate if two consecutive runs name it.
